header: The board that signs off studio strategy
subheadline: Atlas Studio stays employee-owned, so the board is deliberately small: the founder, one voice from the client side, and an external chair. They meet four times a year to approve hiring plans, studio investment and the annual rate card.

members.name: Ana Marques
members.title: Founder and Chair
members.bio: Founded the studio in 2016 and still leads discovery on two engagements a year, most recently the Kestrel Bank onboarding rebuild.

members.name: Margarida Alves
members.title: Non-executive Director
members.bio: Runs operations for a fleet of 900 vehicles and brings the client side of the table into every roadmap review.

members.name: Stefan Holzer
members.title: External Chair
members.bio: Chartered accountant who has chaired three employee-owned agencies. Keeps the rate card and the cash reserve honest.
